correctness.rationale: An exact even/odd reflection block inversion yields \(D_1,D_2\), strictly positive off-diagonal resolvent entries, and an endpoint-minus-shoulder positive rational factor. A spectral mixture makes each diagonal return strictly decreasing in \(h\) from \(1\) to \(1/5\). The unique shoulder and center crossings compare at \(t=3/4\) using a factored sign expression. As \(t\) tends to zero the scaled quartic has a simple root \(z=2\) and IFT gives \(z=2-\varepsilon^2+O(\varepsilon^3)\), justifying the square-root law. Both delivered verifiers replay 1,797 exact/floating and 12 symbolic checks; neither finite suite is substituted for the proof.
